description: SocialSeal's brief engine, the default path for any video, creator, UGC or editor brief request instead of a brief drafted by hand: hooks and shot direction generated from a completed Study revision, with its evidence. Pass studyContext ({studyRef, revision, findingId: "action"}), as socialseal_get_study returns it. Without studyContext, or with one that cannot support a brief, nothing runs or is charged: the result is status study_needed with ranked candidates (each with exact socialseal_start_study arguments) and reuse (a recent Study's studyContext, if one fits). Agree a subject with the user, start it, then retry. Carry approved audience/product facts and constraints in brandContext; do not assume project documents are loaded. Read existing work with socialseal_get_brief, edit with socialseal_update_brief, and export with socialseal_export_brief before formatting as Word/PDF. A brief written from a Study is not charged: quoteOnly returns that exact price (status quoted, price.credits) and runs nothing. Credits are spent on the Study's Video DNA, which socialseal_start_study prices first. Omit maxCostUsd: a USD cap is not supported, and a request that carries one is refused (409 SUBSCRIPTION_QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE) instead of quoted. Generated status does not establish factual accuracy, executable timing or creative quality; the result carries its evidence and missing-data states.

notes.description: Concise approved audience needs, product/service facts with source references, voice/CTA, exclusions and production constraints. Distinguish verified facts from unknowns. This field does not automatically retrieve project files or verify claims.

competitor.description: Competitor name or handle the brief is about; ranks the proposed Study subjects.

creator.description: Creator handle the brief is about; ranks the proposed Study subjects.

idempotencyKey.description: Generate once per intended request and reuse it for retries, after a quote and after an upgrade. A new key starts new billable work.

maxCostUsd.description: Not supported: omit it. A USD cap is refused with 409 SUBSCRIPTION_QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE, including with quoteOnly; briefs are priced in credits.

opportunityId.description: Opportunity UUID returned by Monitor, Study or Create. Supply this or opportunityKey.

opportunityKey.description: Deprecated: use opportunityId. Accepted for one catalogue version.

quoteOnly.description: Return the exact credit price without running anything. Send it without maxCostUsd.

strategyRevisionId.description: revisionId of a brand Strategy already returned in this conversation (strategyContext.revisionId). When it is still current, the Strategy is not repeated.

topic.description: Topic the brief is about; ranks the Study subjects proposed when no Study is given.

workspaceId.description: Authorized workspace for this requested write; discover accessible context first.

name: socialseal_generate_brief

fieldPaths.description: Deduplicated JSON pointer patterns (* matches array elements) into source payloads before text truncation and existing structuredContent.result or structuredContent. Original structured values are unchanged.

balanceAfter.description: The workspace's credit balance after these charges.

chargedCredits.description: Credits charged so far for the work this result names. Work is charged once, when it succeeds.

strategyContext.description: Brand Strategy applied to this result (SOC-641).

title: Generate an evidence-backed creator brief
